newsitem.title: USA: Miller Industries to buy 30 towing companies.
newsitem.headline: Miller Industries to buy 30 towing companies.

text.p: Miller Industries Inc said on Tuesday it will buy 30 towing companies in a bid to create a national towing service network.

Miller said it had signed definitive agreements to buy 18 towing companies for $7.5 million in cash, and 2.3 million Miller shares. The company also has signed letters of intent to acquire 12 additional towing companies.
The combined annual revenues of the 30 companies to be acquired total more than $75 million.
Miller Industries manufactures towing equipment. It plans to create a national towing network of owned and affiliated companies.
